description: Request payload for the `spec.coverage.matrix` query: the story-to-criterion-to-Ticket coverage matrix of one Spec version (DR-PS-18). A null `version` reads the version the Spec's Tickets answer to — the approved one when operative, otherwise the working content.

spec_id.description: The Spec whose coverage matrix is rendered.

version.description: The content version the matrix reports; null reads the approved version when one is operative, else the current one.

title: SpecCoverageMatrixQuery
